notes.title: Tactics meets light horror - play the Demonschool demo now!
notes.content:
Hello friends!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1900250/Demonschool/]We've just released a huge demo of our upcoming game Demonschool[/url], representing (nearly) a full in-game week from about 10% of the way through game's main story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621788/b75708af725f0e1757d6e27ea3f3048f85991bca.png[/img]

Demonschool is an RPG with tactical battles and a heavy story emphasis and influences from Italian horror films and Japanese horror manga. There are relationships to build, skills to learn, minigames, and a spooky but not scary story alongside a hybrid 2D/3D artstyle with unique vibes.
This demo is quite long! Since the game has a multi-day, multi-week structure, you can play it in bite-sized bursts or all at once, but we expect about 3 hours of content in here for someone looking to see everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621788/097082ee4db7260bcd00aeaa3757795c65f07740.png[/img]

There's much more development to be done but this should give you a strong impression of what the final game will be like. If you enjoy this you'll likely enjoy the final experience. You'll see more environments, more enemies, more story, more spookiness, and more goofiness.
Thanks for playing, and please wishlist the game if you like it! Enjoy!!
P.S. we've just revealed our release date - it's friday the 13th, September, 2024!

[previewyoutube=IapvUBGOB8Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hyper Gunsport saves the original from the closure of Stadia
notes.content:
Hyper Gunsport released on Steam and itch.io with Native Linux support back in December 2022, and now the developer has sort-of rescued the original Stadia exclusive Gunsport with it.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/01/hyper-gunsport-saves-the-original-from-the-closure-of-stadia

notes.title: Hyper Gunsport is out!
notes.content:
At long last!! We've been working on this game on and off for a number of years now, and many times wondered if we'd ever be able to finish it, and release it the way we wanted. But eight years, five cancellations, two publishers come and gone, and one shuttered platform later, we can finally share Hyper Gunsport with the world!

We want to thank everyone for their patience, and for believing in this humble little game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621788/e0eddfb4e449b6445def8b59b7f68baf7ed8b23e.png[/img]

notes.title: Hyper Gunsport on Steam Deck
notes.content:
Whilst Hyper Gunsport is not yet Steam Deck verified, we are happy to announce that the game has full support for Steam Deck! Hyper Gunsport has a fully native SteamOS/Linux version that runs at a locked 60fps on Steam Deck and plays great with the in-built controls. We also have full support for Steam Cloud saves, including Dynamic Cloud Sync! This means you can switch from Steam Deck to any PC device (and back!) without closing the game on your Deck and never lose progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621788/c92ecf7ee9014fa5c62564f8cb2d02af4ba99c7f.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Native Linux support!
[*]1280x800 screen support!
[*]60 fps!
[*]Steam Cloud Save with Dynamic Sync support. 
[/list]

[i]EDIT - Jan 3rd 2023[/i]
Hyper Gunsport is now verified as Steam Deck compatible!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621788/fbc54ba366fc166aeb25a9a158051a4b8e5fe3fc.png[/img]
